sections.Profile:
Williams' Full House and Top Hand are electro-mechanical pinball machines released in 1966, both designed by Norm Clark with a poker theme. Full House is the replay version, while Top Hand is the add-a-ball variant

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
sections.Editions:
- Top Hand: 2,600 made, released 1966-04-01, model number 330
- Full House: 2,900 made, released 1966-03-01, model number 321
